content.title: How Much Does the 2026 Masters Winner Earn? All About the Record-Breaking Purse
content.text: NEED TO KNOW The 2026 Masters winner will take home a record-breaking amount of moneyEach year, the historic tournament divides prize money amongst the top playersWhen Rory McIlroy won in 2025, he took home a whopping $4.2 million The 2026 Masters introduced a new round of golfers and potential champions. The annual tournament, which began on April 9, features the return of the most successful professional golfers competing at Augusta National Club in Augusta, Ga. At the end of the four days, one high-performing person takes home the multi-million dollar purse. Each year, the Masters doles out millions of dollars in a grand prize that is divided among the players with the best scores. The winner, of course, gets the majority of the prize. In 2025, champion Rory McIlroy walked away with a record-breaking $4.2 million from the $21 million total purse. Meanwhile, 2024 champion Scottie Scheffler took home $3.6 million in addition to the title, the famous green jacket and more. So, how much do the winners and other players take home from the historic event this year? Here's everything to know about the 2026 Masters purse. How much does the 2026 champion win? Scottie Scheffler poses with the Masters trophy after winning the 2024 Masters Tournament on April 14, 2024 in Augusta, Georgia. Warren Little/Getty The 2026 Masters winner will make $4.5 million from a $22.5 million purse. How much did the 2025 Masters champion earn? Scottie Scheffler on the 18th hole during the final round of the 2024 Masters Tournament on April 14, 2024, in Augusta, Ga. David Cannon/Getty The 2025 Masters purse was $21 million and the champion — McIlroy — took home $4.2 million, per the PGA Tour. According to Statista, the Masters purse has grown significantly every year since 2021, as have the winner's earnings. How much do the other Masters participants make? Ludvig Aberg on the 17th hole during the final round of the 2024 Masters Tournament on April 14, 2024, in Augusta, Ga. David Cannon/Getty In 2025, second place winner, Justin Rose, earned $2.268 million, while third place Patrick Reed took home $1.428 million, per the PGA Tour. This year, runner-ups will walk away with slightly more. The second place winner of the 2026 Masters will earn $2.43 million, while third place will take home $1.53 million. How much have Masters winners won in years past? Scottie Scheffler of the United States plays his shot on the 18th hole during the final round of the 2024 Masters Tournament. Andrew Redington/Getty The prize money at the Masters Tournament has seen significant growth since its inaugural year in 1934. The prize pool has nearly quadrupled in the last two decades, with the biggest jump being the $3.5 million increase from 2021 to 2022, per Statista. In 2024, Scheffler took home $3.6 million. Looking further back, the Masters champion received $3.24 million in 2023 and $2.7 million in 2022. The winner's prize has jumped significantly within the last decade, as the Masters winner in 2016 won $1.8 million. How much do caddies make at the Masters? Rory McIlroy on the 15th green during the second round of Masters Tournament at Augusta National Golf Club on April 12, 2024, in Augusta, Ga. Ben Jared/PGA TOUR via Getty Though players have the most money on the line at the Masters, they aren't the only ones leaving with a paycheck. Caddies are paid a weekly wage between $2,000 to $4,000, which varies based on experience, plus a percentage of the player's tournament earnings, the Association of Professional Caddies and the Caddies Network told CBS News. The caddie of the Masters winner earns 10% of the player's paycheck, meaning they could also walk away with six figures for four days of work. Meanwhile, the caddie of the runner-up gets 7% of their paycheck, while the rest of the caddies make 5%. However, if a caddie's player doesn't make the cut, they will only be paid the weekly wages, Caddies Network CEO John von Stade told CBS. "Caddies are treated really great at Augusta," Ken Martin, who caddied for Scottish golfer Sandy Lyle in 2024, told the outlet. "We had our own locker room. They feed us just wonderful food — the best food I've ever had really." Which golf tournament has the highest payout? Rory McIlroy plays his shot from the 18th tee during the second round of The Players Championship on March 14, 2025, in Ponte Vedra Beach, Fla. Richard Heathcote/Getty Though the Masters has a high payout, it's not the largest among golf tournaments. According to CBS Sports, the Players Championship holds the record for the biggest purse, with $25 million doled out in March 2026. The other major golf tournaments — the PGA Championship, the Open Championship and the U.S. Open — offer substantial prize money, too. The 2025 PGA Championship saw a $19 million purse, while the 2025 U.S. Open and the Open Championship had a prize fund of $21.5 million and $17 million, respectively.
